name: Kindroid
tagline: Kindroid is an AI companion app focused on building a persistent, deeply personalised relationship with an AI character you define — with long-term memory, a custom backstory, and consistent personality across conversations. It supports voice calls, image sharing, and journaling features that make interactions feel ongoing rather than session-based. Users seeking a thoughtful, relationship-oriented AI experience choose Kindroid over more entertainment-focused alternatives.
